```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(rvest)
library(plotly)
```


```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
noaa = 
  read_csv("./data/nynoaadat.csv") |> 
  slice_head(n = 5000) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "\\-") |> 
  unite(date, year,month, sep = ".") |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id),
    snow = as.integer(snow)
    ) |> 
  select(id:snwd, -day) |> 
  filter(!is.na(prcp))


noaa_tmin = 
  read_csv("./data/nynoaadat.csv") |> 
  filter(!is.na(tmin)) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "\\-") |> 
  unite(date, year,month, sep = ".") |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id),
    snow = as.integer(snow)
    ) |> 
  select(-day) |> 
  filter(!is.na(prcp))
```

{data-width=650 .tabset}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatterplot

```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
noaa |> 
  group_by(id, date) |> 
  summarize(
    prcp = mean(prcp),
    snow = mean(snow)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x=~date, y=~prcp, color =~snow, type ="scatter", mode = "markers", colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Snow (mm)"))) |> 
  layout(title = list(text = 'Average Precipitation vs Snowfall from 2007-2010', y =0.99, x = 0.5), xaxis = list(title="Date (Year.Month)"), yaxis = list(title="Preciptiation (mm)"))
```

### Boxplot

```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
noaa|> 
  filter(str_detect(date, "2010")) |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id)) |> 
  filter( id !="US1NYAB0016") |> 
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x=~id, y=~prcp, color =~id, type ="box", title = ""
  ) |> 
  layout(title = 'Precipitation of Active Weather Stations in 2010', xaxis = list(title="Weather Station"), yaxis = list(title="Preciptiation (mm)"))
```


### Histogram2D

```{r echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
noaa_tmin |> 
  mutate(
    tmin = tmin/100) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x =~precip,
    y =~tmin,
    type = 'histogram2d') |> 
  layout(title = list(text = "Precipitation vs Minimum Temperature", y = 0.99, x =0.5),
         xaxis = list(title = "Precipitation (mm)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (*C)"))

```
